Their independent-edge dissipator D=Σ D[Vij] has HS-orthogonal spaces scalar eigenvalue 0, symmetric zero-diagonal eigval -(N-2), traceless diagonal and skew zero-diagonal eigval -N. The coherent -i[Jxi S,.] has zero HS-real part; bD[Q] is nonpositive quadratic form, so every nonstationary eigenoperator has Re λ <= -a(N-2), a=J² Δt ξ(1-ξ)(1-κ²)>0. HS contraction on traceless part excludes nontrivial Jordan chains at boundary, hence semisimple. Constant-row-sum linear constraints give dim C(N-2,2) for N>=6 and 0<κ<1, exception N4 dim 3; at κ=0 only Xu constraint, dim C(N-1,2).
